🔒 Till auto-lock — quick help
Keep the billing screen safe when a cashier steps away — without logging out or losing the open bill.
1 Auto-lock — how long the till may sit untouched before it locks. The open cart is kept; the cashier just re-enters a code to carry on.
2 My unlock PIN — each cashier sets a quick 4-digit code. Until they set one, they unlock with their normal login password.
